products.description:
The Better Choice Gold Special Home Loan offers a standard variable loan. This loan suits borrowers that are looking for
flexibility with their home loan and investment properties with a fully transactionable 100% Offset account.
products.name: Gold Prime Residential Special Home Loans

constraints.additionalInfo: Minimum value for a loan is $100,000

eligibility.additionalInfo: Provide sufficient security and provide satisfactory assessment in accordance with Better Choice’s credit assessment criteria
Be an Australian corporate trustee as trustee for a family trust, (provided the corporate trustee is a non-trading entity) and the family trust beneficiaries are all individuals
Entity must be able to provide a stable income to make repayments on the loan
be an Australian citizen or Australian permanent resident (limited exceptions may apply subject to conditions)
eligibility.additionalValue: An Australian citizen, permanent resident or Australian resident for tax purposes

features.additionalInfo: If you have a variable loan you can make as many extra payments as you want, with no penalty at anytime
Pay interest only. You can pay just the interest for up to 5 years if its an investment property.

products.description: The Better Choice Prime Alt Doc Variable Home Loan offers a standard variable loan with the option to use alternative forms to verify income. Available up to 85% LVR, this loan suits borrowers that are looking for flexibility with their home loan and investment properties
products.name: Prime Alt Doc (BNK)

constraints.additionalInfo: Minimum value for a loan is $50,000
The maximum acceptable LVR for this product is 85%

eligibility.additionalInfo:
The customer must also meet Better Choice’s credit criteria, including demonstration of ability to meet
repayment obligations offer acceptable residential property as security

A company and meet the following requirements:
- Satisfactory investigation by BNK; and
- Company borrowing being supported by the personal guarantee of the director(s). Guarantees
from companies & trusts are not acceptable
An Australian corporate trustee as trustee for a family trust, (provided the corporate trustee is a nontrading entity) and the family trust beneficiaries are all individuals
be an Australian citizen or Australian permanent resident (limited exceptions may apply subject to conditions)
eligibility.additionalValue: An Australian citizen, permanent resident or Australian resident for tax purposes

features.additionalInfo: If you have a variable loan you can make as many extra payments as you want, with no penalty at anytime
Fully transactional 100% Offset Account. Note Better Choice offset sub-accounts do not have access by cards.
Pay interest only. You can pay just the interest for up to 5 years for both Owner Occupied and Investment properties
